The '''Xenoform Marshes''' was the swamp lands east of the "[[Green Ellipse]]" and south of the [[Equation Enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asation]]. The [[Grand Hypergate]] was built in the marshes.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Equation Enclave first appeared in the Operation "Terror From Beyond" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
